rationale: The assistant asked the right first check (compare both hinge sides for a broken or slack spring), correctly used the customer's report of 'a loose spring hanging down on the right side' to reach the right diagnosis, and sensibly asked for the model number without claiming a specific part fits. Weaknesses: it told the customer to 'replace the hinge assembly (which includes the springs) on that side' rather than the spring/cable kit replaced as a pair, did not warn that the spring is under tension, never asked whether the unit can be pulled out (which the customer in fact cannot do), and the advice to 'remove the inner door panel' is not how integrated hinge springs are usually accessed. Power isolation and the engineer fallback were appropriate, and nothing was fabricated.
